requirements.statement: Team members can write meeting notes for each meeting.
requirements.source_quote: Team members can write meeting notes for each meeting.
ambiguity_notes: Who counts as a team member is not defined.
Where meetings come from (existing meeting records or created here) is not defined.
Whether one or several notes per meeting are allowed is not defined.
Note content and format (plain text, rich text, attachments) are not defined.

requirements.statement: Notes can be shared with other team members.
requirements.source_quote: Notes can be shared with other team members.
ambiguity_notes: Who may share a note (author only or others) is not defined.
How sharing works (per person, per team, per meeting) is not defined.
Default visibility of an unshared note is not defined.
Whether sharing can be withdrawn is not defined.

requirements.statement: Only the author can edit a note unless they share edit access.
requirements.source_quote: Only the author can edit a note unless they share edit access.
ambiguity_notes: How edit access differs from sharing (view access) is not defined.
Whether edit access can be revoked, and whether editors can re-share or delete, is not defined.
Whether deletion is covered by 'edit' is not defined.

clarifying_questions.question: Who is a team member, and can anyone outside the team read or share notes?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Defines the user roles and the permission boundary for all three requirements.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Permissions cannot be specified and notes could be exposed to the wrong people.

clarifying_questions.question: Where do meetings come from, and can a meeting have more than one note?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Determines the data model linking notes to meetings.

clarifying_questions.question: How is edit access granted and revoked, and can people with edit access share, re-share or delete the note?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Sets the permission model, including a possibly irreversible delete.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Edit and delete rights cannot be specified.

clarifying_questions.question: Is an unshared note private to its author, or visible to the whole team by default?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Sets the default visibility and the meaning of 'shared'.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Default privacy of notes is unknown.

proposed_status_changes.reason: Sharing mechanism, recipients and default visibility are not stated.
Granting, revoking and scope of edit access (including delete and re-share) are not stated.
